# Greekly

> Greekly (App Store name "Greekly AI: Learn Greek") is an iPhone app for learning Modern Greek, the language of Greece and Cyprus today. It generates quizzes, dialogues, letters, vocabulary and sentence-building exercises with AI around the learner's own life, in five practice modes, a few minutes a day. It is free to start with no account and no email, then Greekly Monthly costs $4.99 a month in the US App Store (local prices vary). No ads, no analytics or tracking SDKs. Developed by WCBO LLC (Beaverton, Oregon, USA; operations hub in Limassol, Cyprus).

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17.4 or later. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6810982667
- Practice modes: Quiz (20 questions per session with an explanation after every answer), Dialogue (everyday conversations line by line), Letter (write a short message in Greek and get it corrected), Words (vocabulary with spaced repetition and audio), Sentence constructor (build sentences from tiles).
- Free plan: 5 exercises a day for the first 6 days, all five modes.
- Teaches Modern Greek only, not Ancient, Koine or Biblical Greek. It is a practice tool, not a teacher and not a certification.
- Also available as Telegram bots: @greekly_bot (English interface) and @greek_a2_bot (Russian interface). They are separate products with separate accounts.
- Contact: support@greekly.eu

## Guides (English)

- [How to learn Greek](https://greekly.eu/learn-greek/): step-by-step plan from the alphabet to real conversations, grammar order, whether Greek is hard, how long it takes.
- [Greek learning app](https://greekly.eu/learn-greek-app/): what a good app to learn Greek should do, and how Greekly's five modes work.
- [Basic Greek phrases](https://greekly.eu/greek-phrases/): 70+ everyday phrases with Greek script, pronunciation and meaning.
- [Learn Greek in Cyprus](https://greekly.eu/learn-greek-cyprus/): Standard vs Cypriot Greek, where to take classes, Greek for residence paperwork.
- [Greek A2 level](https://greekly.eu/learn-greek-a2/): what the CEFR A2 level means in Greek, grammar and topics.
- [Greek A2 exam](https://greekly.eu/greek-a2-exam/): the Certificate of Attainment in Greek (ellinomatheia) at A2, format, who needs it, preparation.
